items.kind: TC-BR-109 — A Branch assigns its suppliers to its Agencies instead of permitting them
items.ref: Severity High · P1 · Business Rule · Backend
items.body: Supplier NDCsbr with credential NDCSabre staging (313) was added to Branch BRN265. With no edit to Agency AGN9780, the Agency’s stored record returned that supplier as assigned, with credential 313 selected in its PCC tab; before the Branch change the same record held Sabre alone. A supplier and a GDS credential therefore reach an Agency without anyone deciding the Agency should have them, and the Agency’s Auto Reissue picker then offers a credential nobody chose for it. Re-executed as a controlled detach / re-attach: detaching the supplier from the Branch removed it from the Agency, and re-attaching it to the Branch alone put it back with its credential — so the Agency’s supplier set simply tracks its Branch’s, in both directions. PO-27 makes the Branch a ceiling, not a source of assignment. Full write-up: ManualExecutionResults.md §3.1.

items.kind: TC-AGENCY-092 — An inactive credential is still offered in the Agency picker
items.ref: Severity Low · P3 · documentation gap, not an application defect
items.body: With credential NDCSabre staging Inactive, the Agency’s saved selection correctly dropped it and Auto Reissue stayed ticked, but the picker still offered it. The Branch screen, in the same window, correctly hid it. run-006 found the same behaviour and the user decided on 2026-09-26 that it is intended, because the API refuses the save — but that decision was never written into the case, so the approved Expected Result still says “not offered” and this execution must record a failure. Reproduced in a second, independent inactive window with the same result. The fix belongs in Stage 3. Full write-up: ManualExecutionResults.md §3.1.

items.kind: TC-BR-107 — A created Branch does not keep the Auto Reissue setting it was created with
items.ref: Severity High · P1 · Data Integrity · Reproducibility Always
items.body: Executed twice. Branch BRN514, then BRN515 on a re-run that completed the cascading location fields first, were each created (POST 204) and approved, and each reopened with Auto Reissue unticked and no Product Access supplier. On the re-run the live form was read from the DOM immediately before submitting and showed Auto Reissue on, Auto Reissue Credentials GalileoLive, and Galileo ticked — which removes the form-model reset that left the first attempt Inconclusive. A Branch created with Auto Reissue on silently does not have it, and is approved in that wrong state. Editing a Branch afterwards saves correctly, so the fault is confined to the create path. Full write-up: ManualExecutionResults.md §3.1.

sections.title: Requirement Coverage
blocks: Coverage is computed from the approved Requirement Traceability Matrices (agency §5, branch §5). Every requirement named below appears there.

items: VERIFIED — checkbox present and default off (PO-15); the picker appears only while ticked (ASM-019); eligible-supplier rules (PO-21, S-9): Galileo and TravelportNdc offered, Amadeus and an LCC not; save and read back, on and off (S-10, S-1, spec §4); off keeps the saved credentials (S-7); maker–checker on the new field (XC-01, XC-04, PO-24); every API save rule (S-2 to S-8); read-time clean-up of an invalid credential (spec §4); a Branch change does not alter its Agencies’ checkbox; the Portal hides Reissue when the Agency’s checkbox is off (PO-25); an Agency Portal cannot see its Branch’s own bookings (PO-26).

NOT VERIFIED — PO-27, the Branch / Agency supplier boundary: TC-BR-109 contradicts it, and TC-AGENCY-074 could not be set up because of the same behaviour. Creating a Branch with Auto Reissue on (TC-BR-107) is unresolved.

OUT OF THIS RUN’S REACH — the whole PO-30 Reissue-button display rule. All 20 of its cases carry Review: Pending and were never authorized to run; three of them (TC-AGENCY-095, 096, 097) have never been executed by any run.

CONFIRMED — TC-AGENCY-070 and TC-BR-105: an inactive credential is refused by the API and dropped from the saved selection on read, both confirmed inside the inactive window. TC-BR-088: a TravelportNdc credential does exist on this environment and is offered.
REFUTED — TC-BR-109’s assumption that a Branch can hold a supplier its Agency does not.
UNVERIFIED — TC-AGENCY-074’s assumption that a branch-only credential can exist at all; TC-BR-107’s create behaviour.

RECORDED FOR A DECISION — TC-AGENCY-093 and TC-BR-111 (exploratory): with the supplier Inactive, both organisations keep Auto Reissue ticked, drop the credential from the saved selection, still list the supplier as assigned, and still offer its credential in the picker. The specification covers an inactive credential, not an inactive supplier.
20 cases never ran. Stage 3 Revision 5 reset the Reissue-button cases to Review: Pending on 2026-10-01; Stage 4M executes only approved cases, so they are Excluded and kept out of the pass rate.
The opening count was wrong by one. The run was opened against 48 approved cases; the true figure is 49. TC-AGENCY-080 was found before the delivery closed, executed, and passed.

A shared supplier was inactive longer than intended. NDCsbr was left Inactive for about 7 minutes when the first attempt’s restore step failed, affecting every organisation that uses it. It was found, restored, and the window re-run cleanly.
Not captured: video and console logs. Screenshots, API status codes, response bodies and structured observations were captured.
REC-010-1 — Decide on TC-BR-109: either the Branch stops assigning its suppliers to its Agencies, or PO-27 is restated to say that it does and the Agency cases are rewritten against that.
REC-010-2 — Amend TC-AGENCY-092’s Expected Result to match the decision already taken in run-006, or reopen that decision. Until then the case fails on every run.
REC-010-3 — Re-run TC-BR-107 with the location fields completed before Product Access and Auto Reissue.
REC-010-4 — Answer the exploratory question: should an inactive supplier’s credential disappear from the picker, as an inactive credential does on the Branch screen?
REC-010-5 — Re-approve the 20 Reissue-button cases in Stage 3 so the PO-30 display rule can actually be tested.
REC-010-6 — Keep supplier NDCsbr and credential 313 attached to BRN265 permanently, as run-008’s REC-008-4 already recommended.
